translation.title: Benzoyl Peroxide Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for acne vulgaris (common acne).
translation.usage: Wash the affected area clean, then apply the gel 1 to 2 times a day, patting it in gently. When starting treatment, apply once a day at bedtime; once your skin has adapted well, increase to twice a day (morning and evening). The amount used is adjusted according to the response to treatment and how well your skin tolerates the medicine.
translation.caution: Do not apply this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have inflammation, on wounds or pre-existing skin lesions, or on skin that already showed irritation during preliminary treatment. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have dry or oily atopic skin or macerated (raw, oozing) skin, if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to this medicine, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or for children. Use a mild facial cleanser (wash your face at most twice a day) and do not use cosmetics containing perfume or alcohol. At the start of and during treatment, avoid exposure to sunlight and use a sunscreen product. Do not use UV lamps. Take particular care if you have a fair complexion or on areas where the skin is delicate. This medicine is for external use only. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. This medicine can bleach hair and colored fabrics. Do not use it together with other therapeutic topical keratolytic (skin-peeling) agents or cleansers, or with other topical acne medicines (including acne medicines containing vitamin A derivatives). If severe or persistent irritation occurs, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
